records.title: OpenLife: Toward Open-World Artificial Life with Autonomous LLM Agents
records.reason: OpenLife studies autonomous LLM-agent behavior under budgeted activity; it does not optimize model inference.

records.title: Revising RVL-CDIP: Quantifying Errors and Test-Train Overlap
records.reason: RVL-CDIP label-error and train/test-overlap audit for document classification benchmarks; no LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Communication-Aware Robot Execution for Cloud Inference under Spatially Heterogeneous Connectivity
records.reason: The method estimates cloud request/response timing and selects robot request locations with a communication-aware planner. Simulated outcomes improve task success/request reliability; the intervention is robot communication/motion planning, not model inference efficiency.
